page_title: VIL 2-1 MAL | Villarreal v Mallorca 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90+7' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+5' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+4' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
90+4' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Mallorca will take a throw-in.
90+3' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) attempts to find Takuma Asano, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.

89' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Luiz Junior (Villarreal). This is a yellow card! Luiz Junior (Villarreal) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
89' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 15:6.
87' Takuma Asano sprays a pass out to Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the right post.
86' A substitution has been made. Omar Mascarell goes off and Javier Llabres (Mallorca) comes on.
86' Here is a change. Mateo Joseph is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
86' That will be all from Antonio Sanchez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Takuma Asano (Mallorca).
86' PENALTY APPEAL after Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

85' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Jose Guzman to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Villarreal players can finally celebrate. Goal - 2:1. Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) is first to the rebound and finds the back of the net with a brilliant back-heel finish.
84' Wait! Referee Jose Guzman immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
83' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
81' The free kick into the penalty area from Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is cleared.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) comes onto the pitch for Rafa Marin.
79' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
78' The Villarreal players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Jose Guzman. NO PENALTY!
76' Celebrations by Villarreal are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.

75' Jose Guzman blows his whistle after Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. PENALTY to Villarreal! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
75' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Johan Mojica (Mallorca) receives a yellow card!
74' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) replacing Jan Virgili.
74' Substitution. Alberto Moleiro will be replaced by Manor Solomon (Villarreal).

72' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Lucas Bergstrom shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.

72' A cross into the box from Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) is cleared. Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) controls a rebound and tries to catch the keeper out from long range, but it's a poor effort that sails well wide of the left post.
71' The attendance is 16854.
70' 10:7 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 5:3.
69' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) replaces Pablo Torre.
67' Lucas Bergstrom (Mallorca) attempts to delay the restart of play. The referee doesn't like it. The referee is firm and issues Lucas Bergstrom (Mallorca) a deserved yellow card.

66' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
64' Samu Costa (Mallorca) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
63' Substitution. Thomas Partey is replaced by Pape Gueye (Villarreal).
63' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Gerard Moreno is replaced by Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal).
63' Ayoze Perez goes off the pitch and Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) comes on.
62' Samu Costa (Mallorca) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.

60' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Lucas Bergstrom shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
57' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
55' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
54' The ball is cleared after Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
53' The Villarreal players are exchanging some short passes.
49' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
48' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) picks out Pablo Torre with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
47' A pass into the box finds Santi Comesana (Villarreal) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Lucas Bergstrom denies him.
46' A pass from Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) is intercepted by Lucas Bergstrom and the move breaks down.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+2' What a great effort! Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
44' The corner from Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is cleared away by the defence.

43' What a great touch by Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.

42' Lucas Bergstrom pulls off a fine save! Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header low towards the middle, but the effort is kept out.
41' Marcelino isn't happy on the touchline after referee Jose Guzman shows him a yellow card.
37' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the shot whistles inches wide of the left post.
36' Poor challenge! Pau Navarro (Villarreal) is penalised for tripping and Jose Guzman blows his whistle. Mallorca are awarded the free kick.
35' Rafa Marin (Villarreal) plays a terrific long ball forward to Alberto Moleiro, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
34' Half-chance! Jan Virgili (Mallorca) plays a pass into the box, but Luiz Junior reacts well to snuff out the attack.
32' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:3. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:2.
30' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
27' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

25' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Santi Comesana (Villarreal) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Lucas Bergstrom was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
25' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
25' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Gerard Moreno (Villarreal), but the defence gets it clear. The referee blows his whistle, Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
24' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
23' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Luiz Junior is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
22' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
20' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ayoze Perez.
19' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
18' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
16' 60:40 – the ratio of ball possession.
12' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
10' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Guzman blows his whistle for a foul.

8' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Pablo Torre, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Samu Costa (Mallorca), who beats Luiz Junior with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
6' 1 - 0 GOAL! Ayoze Perez meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 1:0.
6' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) plays a one-two with Ayoze Perez, but the move breaks down.
5' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
4' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Lucas Bergstrom comes off the line to clear the ball away.
2' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) sends a chip pass into the box, but Luiz Junior is quickest to intercept the ball.
